points.point: The Vault assigns R&S ZNA to component-level satellite payload testing covering converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements
points.label: covered
points.why: states ZNA for component-level satellite payload testing of listed components plus noise figure, group delay and phase

points.point: Group delay measurement on frequency converters without LO access (two-tone technique) is a key VNA capability for satellite transponder/converter chains
points.label: covered
points.why: states two-tone group delay for converters without LO access and embedded/internal LO drift/noise

points.point: ZNA supports true parallel and coherent data acquisition for antenna array / antenna test systems from 100 kHz
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention true parallel/coherent data acquisition for antenna arrays/test systems from 100 kHz

points.point: High dynamic range is a stated ZNA key performance figure: >129 dB spec, 147 dB typical with options, up to 170 dB with full 2-port correction
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions high dynamic range, but gives ZNB3020 figures rather than the stated ZNA >129 dB/147 dB/170 dB figures

points.point: mmWave converter support via rear-panel LO out extends S-parameter coverage without an external signal generator
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention rear-panel LO out or mmWave converter support without external signal generator

points.point: Pulsed-signal S-parameter measurement exists as option R&S ZNA-K7 (requires ZNA-K17 plus pulse modulator)
points.label: missing
points.why: mentions pulsed source software generally, not ZNA-K7 S-parameter pulse option requiring ZNA-K17 and pulse modulator

points.point: In the satellite supply-chain solution mapping, ZNA / ZNB3000 are the instruments listed for antenna makers' G/T work
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention satellite supply-chain mapping or ZNA/ZNB3000 for antenna makers' G/T work

points.point: For UAV antennas the Vault maps ZNB3000 to high isolation measurement and OTA passive testing
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention UAV antenna high-isolation measurement or OTA passive testing with ZNB3000
